metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected and organized according to BIDS conventions (version 1.6.0). The dataset includes EEG recordings in .edf format with accompanying BIDS-compliant metadata (.json, .tsv files) documenting acquisition parameters, electrode configurations, sampling rates, and participant information. Pre-intervention baseline EEG recordings were obtained from all participants, followed by an intervention protocol, with post-intervention EEG measurements collected to assess intervention effects. Detailed information about the specific intervention protocol, participant demographics, and clinical context is available in the dataset's accompanying documentation.
